major.00.name: The Fool
major.00.upright: Begin with curiosity and one small, reversible step.
major.00.reversed: Pause before a leap that depends on luck alone; prepare practical support.

major.01.name: The Magician
major.01.upright: Bring the skills and tools you already have into one deliberate action.
major.01.reversed: Check whether preparation has become avoidance or a promise exceeds your practice.

major.02.name: The High Priestess
major.02.upright: Leave room for an observation you cannot yet explain; listen before responding.
major.02.reversed: Balance intuition with evidence, especially where silence prevents a necessary question.

major.03.name: The Empress
major.03.upright: Tend the conditions that help something grow: nourishment, rest, time, and care.
major.03.reversed: Restore a boundary where caring for others is depleting your own resources.

major.04.name: The Emperor
major.04.upright: Make responsibilities and limits clear enough to support steady progress.
major.04.reversed: Ask whether a rule protects useful structure or merely preserves control.

major.05.name: The Teacher
major.05.upright: Learn from a mentor or shared practice and test its wisdom in your circumstances.
major.05.reversed: Distinguish an inherited value worth keeping from a custom that no longer fits.

major.06.name: The Lovers
major.06.upright: Name the values a choice must honor, then compare them with your actions.
major.06.reversed: Make competing loyalties explicit before agreeing to something you cannot sustain.

major.07.name: The Chariot
major.07.upright: Choose a direction and coordinate the effort that will carry you toward it.
major.07.reversed: More force will not resolve a conflict of direction; reconsider the destination.

major.08.name: Strength
major.08.upright: Meet a difficult impulse with patience; gentle consistency can be courage.
major.08.reversed: Reduce a demand that turns exhaustion into self-criticism and ask for support.

major.09.name: The Hermit
major.09.upright: Step back from constant input long enough to hear your own judgment.
major.09.reversed: Reflection may be becoming isolation; share one unfinished thought with someone trusted.

major.10.name: Wheel of Fortune
major.10.upright: Conditions are changing; notice an opening you can respond to without claiming certainty.
major.10.reversed: Examine a repeated cycle and separate influence from an attempt to control everything.

major.11.name: Justice
major.11.upright: Compare choices with consequences using accurate information and consistent standards.
major.11.reversed: Revisit the evidence and include a perspective missing from your account of events.

major.12.name: The Hanged Man
major.12.upright: A deliberate pause can loosen an old assumption and offer another point of view.
major.12.reversed: Decide what new information would justify waiting and what would let you act.

major.13.name: Death
major.13.upright: Name what is finished and allow an ending to release space for transition.
major.13.reversed: Holding on may be extending an exhausted arrangement; try one small act of letting go.

major.14.name: Temperance
major.14.upright: Combine differences slowly and observe which rhythm you can sustain.
major.14.reversed: Adjust one ingredient of an unbalanced routine instead of changing everything at once.

major.15.name: The Devil
major.15.upright: Name the cost of an attachment that offers relief while reducing your freedom.
major.15.reversed: Support a new distance from an old pattern with a practical limit or honest conversation.

major.16.name: The Tower
major.16.upright: A disrupted assumption reveals what needs support before it can be rebuilt.
major.16.reversed: Address one visible weakness rather than rehearsing every possible collapse.

major.17.name: The Star
major.17.upright: Let hope take a practical form through a habit that restores your longer view.
major.17.reversed: Borrow support when discouragement makes it difficult to imagine renewal.

major.18.name: The Moon
major.18.upright: Move carefully through uncertainty and distinguish impressions from established facts.
major.18.reversed: As confusion lifts, check your interpretation against evidence before calling it an answer.

major.19.name: The Sun
major.19.upright: Share a source of clarity and enjoyment without requiring it to be perfect.
major.19.reversed: Allow mixed feelings instead of using positivity to conceal a real difficulty.

major.20.name: Judgement
major.20.upright: Review an earlier choice with present understanding and choose a responsible response.
major.20.reversed: Define enough clarity to decide instead of waiting to feel entirely ready.

major.21.name: The World
major.21.upright: Recognize meaningful completion by celebrating, documenting, and resting.
major.21.reversed: Identify whether an unfinished detail needs action, acceptance, or a clearer stopping point.

wands.11.name: Page of Wands
wands.11.upright: Follow an interesting question with playful, practical exploration.
wands.11.reversed: Finish one experiment before adding another source of scattered excitement.

wands.06.name: Six of Wands
wands.06.upright: Acknowledge visible progress and the effort behind it.
wands.06.reversed: Define success you can recognize without relying entirely on applause.

wands.08.name: Eight of Wands
wands.08.upright: When events move quickly, confirm essentials and communicate clearly.
wands.08.reversed: Slow an exchange down enough to repair confusion or crossed messages.

wands.14.name: King of Wands
wands.14.upright: Give effort a purpose that others can understand and help shape.
wands.14.reversed: Listen for information that impatience with other people may be hiding.

wands.12.name: Knight of Wands
wands.12.upright: Act on a direction that has earned commitment while remaining open to adjustment.
wands.12.reversed: Check the effect on others before letting impulse outrun preparation.

wands.04.name: Four of Wands
wands.04.upright: Mark a milestone with the people who helped make it possible.
wands.04.reversed: Ask what would make a shared space or celebration more welcoming.

wands.05.name: Five of Wands
wands.05.upright: Let different approaches create useful friction while keeping the purpose shared.
wands.05.reversed: Address a concrete disagreement that is continuing beneath polite avoidance.

wands.01.name: Ace of Wands
wands.01.upright: Give a spark of interest a small experiment and observe whether energy grows.
wands.01.reversed: Improve the conditions for an idea instead of forcing enthusiasm.

wands.10.name: Ten of Wands
wands.10.upright: Sort responsibilities into what only you can do and what can be shared.
wands.10.reversed: Renegotiate a commitment whose burden has outgrown its purpose.

wands.13.name: Queen of Wands
wands.13.upright: Bring warmth and confidence to a space where others can participate.
wands.13.reversed: Return to an activity that feels like your own when comparison dims confidence.

wands.03.name: Three of Wands
wands.03.upright: Prepare to meet the response to work already begun, with patience and cooperation.
wands.03.reversed: Recheck assumptions when an expected response is delayed or different.

wands.02.name: Two of Wands
wands.02.upright: Compare realistic directions so that a desire can become a workable plan.
wands.02.reversed: Choose a limited trial when keeping every option open prevents movement.

wands.09.name: Nine of Wands
wands.09.upright: Use experience to take a manageable step while protecting your recovery.
wands.09.reversed: Ask where support could replace exhausting vigilance against another setback.

wands.07.name: Seven of Wands
wands.07.upright: Protect a position that matters with a clear reason and a sustainable boundary.
wands.07.reversed: Choose which boundary deserves your energy instead of answering every challenge.

cups.10.name: Ten of Cups
cups.10.upright: Notice the repeated acts of care that make belonging possible.
cups.10.reversed: Allow different needs and disagreements inside a valued connection.

cups.08.name: Eight of Cups
cups.08.upright: Name what you are moving toward when leaving something that no longer meets a need.
cups.08.reversed: Describe the conditions under which staying or leaving would feel honest.

cups.05.name: Five of Cups
cups.05.upright: Acknowledge a loss while noticing the support that remains available.
cups.05.reversed: Allow renewed interest to coexist with disappointment that still hurts.

cups.09.name: Nine of Cups
cups.09.upright: Enjoy a satisfaction without immediately raising the standard again.
cups.09.reversed: Explore the need beneath an achievement that feels different from what you expected.

cups.03.name: Three of Cups
cups.03.upright: Seek friendship and shared enjoyment where you can contribute without performing.
cups.03.reversed: Choose a form of connection that nourishes rather than excludes or depletes.

cups.14.name: King of Cups
cups.14.upright: Hold a strong feeling without letting it make every decision.
cups.14.reversed: Name a suppressed emotion in a setting where it can be considered safely.

cups.06.name: Six of Cups
cups.06.upright: Carry a useful tenderness or forgotten interest forward from a memory.
cups.06.reversed: Ask what your present self needs that an idealized past cannot provide.

cups.04.name: Four of Cups
cups.04.upright: Reflect on dissatisfaction and notice an offer you may have overlooked.
cups.04.reversed: Try engaging with one possibility as a period of withdrawal begins to loosen.

cups.01.name: Ace of Cups
cups.01.upright: Make room for a new feeling or an offered kindness; receiving is also an action.
cups.01.reversed: Notice an emotion privately before deciding how to express it.

cups.07.name: Seven of Cups
cups.07.upright: Make the costs and requirements of attractive possibilities concrete.
cups.07.reversed: Release an appealing option that does not fit your actual priorities.

cups.13.name: Queen of Cups
cups.13.upright: Listen with compassion while staying in contact with your own feelings.
cups.13.reversed: Distinguish what is yours to carry from what belongs to someone else.

cups.02.name: Two of Cups
cups.02.upright: Deepen trust through an exchange in which both people can speak and be heard.
cups.02.reversed: Check expectations and reciprocity rather than assuming a connection is balanced.

cups.11.name: Page of Cups
cups.11.upright: Receive a surprising feeling with curiosity and try a tentative expression.
cups.11.reversed: Write a sensitive feeling down before deciding who should hear it.

cups.12.name: Knight of Cups
cups.12.upright: Support a heartfelt invitation with an action that makes it tangible.
cups.12.reversed: Compare an appealing promise with the ordinary behavior behind it.

swords.11.name: Page of Swords
swords.11.upright: Ask careful questions and listen as closely as you investigate.
swords.11.reversed: Verify a quick interpretation before it becomes a rumor or an argument.

swords.12.name: Knight of Swords
swords.12.upright: Use direct action when the objective is clear and consequences have been considered.
swords.12.reversed: Pause long enough to hear a relevant objection to an urgent plan.

swords.05.name: Five of Swords
swords.05.upright: Consider the trust a victory may cost and leave room for future cooperation.
swords.05.reversed: Step out of an unproductive contest by naming a specific harm or limit.

swords.10.name: Ten of Swords
swords.10.upright: Accept the limit of an exhausted plan and focus on the next basic need.
swords.10.reversed: Measure recovery by small changes instead of the intensity of what ended.

swords.01.name: Ace of Swords
swords.01.upright: State an issue precisely so that an honest question can cut through confusion.
swords.01.reversed: Clarify terms and check evidence before defending a strong conclusion.

swords.08.name: Eight of Swords
swords.08.upright: Test one constraint when fear makes a situation feel completely closed.
swords.08.reversed: Practice a small choice as a limiting assumption begins to loosen.

swords.14.name: King of Swords
swords.14.upright: Explain the consistent principle behind a complicated decision so it can be questioned.
swords.14.reversed: Include the human effect of a decision rather than hiding behind detached authority.

swords.09.name: Nine of Swords
swords.09.upright: Share a worry and separate a solvable problem from a feared possibility.
swords.09.reversed: Notice support that helps distress ease without demanding immediate relief.

swords.13.name: Queen of Swords
swords.13.upright: Make a difficult conversation clearer through precise language and humane boundaries.
swords.13.reversed: Check whether past disappointment is making your present judgment too sharp.

swords.02.name: Two of Swords
swords.02.upright: Gather the information that would help you choose between competing considerations.
swords.02.reversed: Identify the smallest decision available when avoidance begins to have its own costs.

swords.03.name: Three of Swords
swords.03.upright: Acknowledge a painful truth without turning it into a harsher story about yourself.
swords.03.reversed: Allow uneven healing without treating a difficult feeling as proof of no progress.

swords.04.name: Four of Swords
swords.04.upright: Give rest a clear place in your routine so that attention can recover.
swords.04.reversed: Re-enter a demanding situation gradually and keep a restorative practice.

swords.06.name: Six of Swords
swords.06.upright: Let a quiet transition carry useful learning toward steadier conditions.
swords.06.reversed: Attend to an unresolved concern that may follow you into a new setting.

swords.07.name: Seven of Swords
swords.07.upright: Check whether a careful strategy could withstand an honest explanation.
swords.07.reversed: Choose a clear account over adding another layer of concealment.

pentacles.12.name: Knight of Pentacles
pentacles.12.theme: pursuit in practical life and resources
pentacles.12.upright: Build reliability through steady attention at a pace you can maintain.
pentacles.12.reversed: Change one part of a routine that has become rigid or stalled.

pentacles.11.name: Page of Pentacles
pentacles.11.theme: curiosity in practical life and resources
pentacles.11.upright: Approach a practical skill as a learner with a modest plan and regular attention.
pentacles.11.reversed: Turn a plan into one small task with a visible finish.

pentacles.07.name: Seven of Pentacles
pentacles.07.theme: assessment in practical life and resources
pentacles.07.upright: Assess what patient effort produces before deciding to continue, change, or stop.
pentacles.07.reversed: Review the method before assuming that more time will improve the result.

pentacles.03.name: Three of Pentacles
pentacles.03.theme: growth in practical life and resources
pentacles.03.upright: Clarify contributions and invite feedback so different skills can improve the work.
pentacles.03.reversed: Agree on roles and standards when cooperation becomes difficult.

pentacles.14.name: King of Pentacles
pentacles.14.theme: stewardship in practical life and resources
pentacles.14.upright: Use experience and resources to support something durable.
pentacles.14.reversed: Ask what security is meant to support beyond possession and control.

pentacles.04.name: Four of Pentacles
pentacles.04.theme: stability in practical life and resources
pentacles.04.upright: Define enough security to protect resources while still allowing movement.
pentacles.04.reversed: Distinguish a prudent reserve from a restriction driven by fear.

pentacles.01.name: Ace of Pentacles
pentacles.01.theme: potential in practical life and resources
pentacles.01.upright: Invest a realistic amount of time or skill in a practical opportunity.
pentacles.01.reversed: Check everyday requirements before committing to a promising start.

pentacles.02.name: Two of Pentacles
pentacles.02.theme: choice in practical life and resources
pentacles.02.upright: Make priorities visible and leave margin for adjustment among competing demands.
pentacles.02.reversed: Simplify an obligation or renegotiate a deadline when too many parts are moving.

pentacles.06.name: Six of Pentacles
pentacles.06.theme: support in practical life and resources
pentacles.06.upright: Make an exchange fair to both the capacity of the giver and dignity of the receiver.
pentacles.06.reversed: Discuss an unspoken obligation or power imbalance in an offer of help.

pentacles.10.name: Ten of Pentacles
pentacles.10.theme: completion in practical life and resources
pentacles.10.upright: Consider the resources, knowledge, and care you want to pass on.
pentacles.10.reversed: Discuss which inherited expectations should continue and which need to change.

pentacles.13.name: Queen of Pentacles
pentacles.13.theme: care in practical life and resources
pentacles.13.upright: Include your own needs in the practical care that makes a space secure.
pentacles.13.reversed: Reserve time for a personal foundation crowded out by caring for everyone else.

pentacles.09.name: Nine of Pentacles
pentacles.09.theme: culmination in practical life and resources
pentacles.09.upright: Enjoy the independence and comfort your efforts support while staying connected.
pentacles.09.reversed: Define sustainable success that includes time and wellbeing, not only appearance.

pentacles.05.name: Five of Pentacles
pentacles.05.theme: challenge in practical life and resources
pentacles.05.upright: Identify a person or resource you could approach during a period of lack.
pentacles.05.reversed: Accept available support as a practical step without making it a measure of worth.

pentacles.08.name: Eight of Pentacles
pentacles.08.theme: movement in practical life and resources
pentacles.08.upright: Choose one detail to improve through repetition and attentive practice.
pentacles.08.reversed: Reconnect repetitive work with a useful goal when perfection or boredom drains it.

positions.situation: What is present in this situation?
positions.next_action: What small action is available to you?
